slides: Welcome back. Two short tools for numbers in a row, before the next two questions. Those questions teach the main rule, count times middle.

slides.say: Remember, how many integers are there from three to ten? The last minus the first, plus one, because both ends count. Ten minus three is seven, and plus one is eight.
Now only the even numbers, from four to twenty. They go in steps of two. So count the steps, twenty minus four is sixteen, sixteen over two is eight steps, and plus one is nine even numbers.
Odd numbers the same way. From three to eleven, eleven minus three is eight, eight over two is four steps, and plus one is five. And really, three, five, seven, nine, eleven.
Second tool. b squared minus a squared is the third shortcut formula, b minus a, times b plus a.
And if a and b are neighbors, with b bigger, then b minus a is one. So b squared minus a squared is just a plus b.
at: if a and b are neighbors

slides.say: Let's see it in numbers. Five squared is twenty-five and four squared is sixteen. Twenty-five minus sixteen is nine, and four plus five is nine. Eight squared is sixty-four and seven squared is forty-nine. Sixty-four minus forty-nine is fifteen, and seven plus eight is fifteen.
But only for neighbors. Six squared is thirty-six and four squared is sixteen. Thirty-six minus sixteen is twenty, not six plus four, which is ten. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next video.
